tags.label: Accountability
tags.definition: Taking ownership of choices, actions, and results.

tags.label: Advertising
tags.definition: Paid or organic promotion that creates awareness and demand.

tags.label: Ambition
tags.definition: The drive to pursue a larger or more difficult outcome.

tags.label: Attention
tags.definition: Deliberate control over where mental energy is invested.

tags.label: Business models
tags.definition: The structural choices governing how a company creates and captures value.

tags.label: Career
tags.definition: Long-term development of professional skill and opportunity.

tags.label: Customer experience
tags.definition: How customers perceive and experience a company across interactions.

tags.label: Decision making
tags.definition: Choosing a course of action under constraints and uncertainty.

tags.label: Execution
tags.definition: Turning priorities and decisions into completed action.

tags.label: Focus
tags.definition: Concentrating resources on the few things that matter most.

tags.label: Goals
tags.definition: Defined outcomes used to direct effort and measure progress.

tags.label: Leadership
tags.definition: Directing people, standards, and organizational responsibility.

tags.label: Learning
tags.definition: Building useful knowledge or capability through study and experience.

tags.label: Marketing
tags.definition: Creating awareness, interest, and qualified demand for an offer.

tags.label: Measurement
tags.definition: Using observable evidence to evaluate capability, progress, or outcomes.

tags.label: Offers
tags.definition: The value proposition, terms, and packaging presented to a market.

tags.label: Opportunity
tags.definition: A favorable possibility that can be acted on before certainty exists.

tags.label: Perspective
tags.definition: A framing that changes how circumstances or outcomes are interpreted.

tags.label: Prioritization
tags.definition: Ranking work by impact and deciding what will not be pursued.

tags.label: Problem solving
tags.definition: Defining obstacles and identifying workable paths through them.

tags.label: Productivity
tags.definition: Producing valuable output with constrained time and attention.

tags.label: Resilience
tags.definition: Continuing through difficulty while preserving the ability to act.

tags.label: Retention
tags.definition: Keeping customers and revenue active over time.

tags.label: Risk
tags.definition: Exposure to uncertain outcomes in pursuit of an opportunity.

tags.label: Sales
tags.definition: Helping qualified prospects make a purchase decision.

tags.label: Sales training
tags.definition: Practice and feedback used to improve selling capability.

tags.label: Scaling
tags.definition: Growing output or revenue without proportional growth in constraints.

tags.label: Small business
tags.definition: Operating and growing a company at an early or owner-led stage.

tags.label: Strategy
tags.definition: A coherent set of choices for winning with limited resources.

tags.label: Stress
tags.definition: Mental strain created by uncertainty, pressure, or unresolved action.

tags.label: Sustainability
tags.definition: Maintaining a company or practice so it can continue over time.

tags.label: Urgency
tags.definition: Acting promptly when delay creates avoidable cost.
